text: The Associate Director, Toronto Drug Strategy Secretariat, will give an overview of actions being taken to respond to the drug poisoning crisis.

The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Executive Committee to direct the Medical Officer of Health and the Associate Director, Toronto Drug Strategy Secretariat to: a. create a specific Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Drug Strategy as a component of the Toronto Drug Strategy; b. incorporate the Committee’s feedback into the creation of the strategy and consult with Sherbourne Health, AIDS service organizations, The 519 and other Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer health service providers; c. create educational materials and campaigns with the objective of promoting sexual health as it relates to the strategy and ending the stigma and discrimination that members of the Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer community face; and d. request the Provincial and…
